app.name: Network Insights
app.description: NetOps observability: device health, NetFlow, topology, compliance, RCA.

scopes.name: storage:logs:read
scopes.comment: config-change, compliance, syslog and trap events from Grail

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: SNMP interface/health metrics for the device fleet

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: resolve the buckets for the fetch/timeseries queries

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: Davis problems for the Alerts view

scopes.name: extensions:configurations:read
scopes.comment: find a device's monitoring config to retire it

scopes.name: extensions:configurations:write
scopes.comment: onboard/retire devices — create/delete SNMP monitoring configs

scopes.name: extensions:definitions:read
scopes.comment: wizard: list installed extensions to advise which are present

scopes.name: credentialVault.read
scopes.comment: list Credential Vault entries (metadata only) so onboarding pickers auto-populate — never reads the secret

scopes.name: state:app-states:read
scopes.comment: read the device→site map (app-owned site grouping)
